representativeSnapshot.kind: production-like disposable database with venue owner, booking manager, requester, and unrelated personas

rowCountQueries: Count booking requests by venue_id and legacy status
Record grants, RLS state, policies, invalid indexes, and invalid constraints for dependency tables
Confirm every reviewed backfill venue_id is an existing public.venue_profiles.id
preflight.expectedAffectedRows: Expansion changes no existing row; the concurrent index is applied in a separate one-statement execution; operator-controlled backfill updates only lifecycle-null rows for one explicit venue_id per invocation

execution.resumeStrategy: Schema statements converge additively; run the concurrent-index companion alone; invoke backfill_venue_booking_lifecycle once per reviewed venue and repeat until it returns zero
execution.idempotency: Columns, constraints, policies, and indexes are guarded; the separate concurrent index uses IF NOT EXISTS; lifecycle transitions use booking_request_id plus client_request_id

quarantine.strategy: No venue ownership is inferred. Unknown legacy statuses map to inquiry only inside an explicitly scoped operator backfill.

constraints: timeline booking, venue, and actor foreign keys
timeline metadata must be a JSON object
constraintsAndIndexes.validationPlan: Validate NOT VALID constraints after scoped backfill, confirm all indexes are valid, then test allowed, denied, duplicate, stale-revision, and invalid lifecycle transitions

recovery.rollback: Disable FEATURE_VENUE_BOOKING_LIFECYCLE; keep legacy status compatibility and preserve additive lifecycle evidence
recovery.forwardFix: Apply a later reviewed additive policy, constraint, function, or indexing migration
